summary: Selloff broadened: S&P 500 ~-0.8% and Nasdaq ~-1.5% as Nvidia trades ~-11% after opening as much as -14% (Huang resigned, Kress interim CEO); AMD/Broadcom green, CoreWeave ~-15%. Live quotes blocked, prices estimated. Change: NVDA bounced off its ~149.4 opening low (breakdown moved there, put -3), QQQ/SPY/CRWV puts +2 on the deeper index drop.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: William Blair upgrade plus share-gain bets on Nvidia's leadership vacuum, up ~2-3% against the tape; over 575 extends toward 584, under 560 the gain fades with the semis.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq ~-1.5% on the Nvidia shock after Wednesday's 690.38 close; under 677 the selloff extends, over 686 dip buyers have it (price estimated).

picks.name: Eli Lilly
picks.reason: Up ~3% premarket on China approval of its oral GLP-1, a defensive haven as tech sells off; over 1500 runs, under 1470 the gap fades (premarket estimate).

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down ~11% from 173.73 after Huang resigned (Kress interim CEO), Bernstein cut target to 200; bounced off a ~149.4 opening low, under it the flush resumes, over 158 the gap-fill bounce extends.

picks.name: CoreWeave
picks.reason: Down ~15% giving back Wednesday's 27% earnings pop as the Nvidia shock hits AI-infrastructure names; under 51.5 extends, over 56.5 the put is wrong (price estimated).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P 500 ~-0.8% as AI stocks drag and the 10-year sits near 5%; under 750 the drop broadens, over 757.5 the market shrugs off Nvidia (price estimated).
